scope: Ethereum current uniETH ETH mint, permissionless 32-ETH validator redemption requests, original-app unstake/instant redemption and fixed credited ETH claim overloads.

lifecycleEvidence.evidence: Current official uniETH app publishes ETH yield/staking product and Ethereum contracts: staking V2 0xE0240d05Ae9eF703E2b71F3f4Eb326ea1888DEa3, original unstake 0x4beFa2aA9c305238AA3E0b5D17eB20C045269E9d, Redeem 0x98169228cB99Ed26c1043eD8Ca53A5Cb371D3B8D. Official docs still explain stake/unstake, and original pool is currently explicitly app-bound for unstake, not documented as retired. Etherscan current V2 page shows Push Validators maintenance dated 2026-10-22; this is maintenance, not DAU. Official linked repository is not archived/disabled but last push 2024-07-19T06:39:11Z; it must NOT be represented as recently updated. No reviewed official uniETH sources announce shutdown/wind-down/deprecation of these targets. Historical uniBTC exploit does not establish uniETH shutdown. No product TVL/DAU claim.

limitations: Inventory admission only; no fresh RPC, bytecode/storage identity, pause-state, funding or executable-behavior assurance.
Use Ethereum native ETH with payable mint and correct minimum minted uniETH/deadline; token approval is independently required for burnFrom redemption.

Validator redemption is permissionless but institutional-oriented: positive multiples of 32 ETH only, maxToBurn/deadline checks, and V2 requires redeemEnabled. No promise that current redemption is enabled.
Validator exits/EigenLayer delays and protocol debt settlement precede fixed Redeem.claim; no privileged oracle/validator settlement capability is admitted.
instantSwap may partially fill based on pending ETH and exposes no min-output/deadline argument; preview and independent slippage controls remain necessary.
The app distinguishes current staking V2 from the still-listed original unstake target; old-pool mint is deliberately excluded.
Historical Bedrock exploit reporting is not treated as shutdown evidence or an assertion of financial safety; lifecycle review is product-specific, not a runtime security audit.

deploymentEvidence.evidence: Exact official Ethereum deployment binding; for Bedrock current app chain config specifies Ethereum uniETH token and distinct staking/unstake/redeem addresses. Explorer is used for V2 proxy resolution because Sourcify has no proxy match.

abiEvidence.evidence: Full deployed implementation ABI and source from exact-address Sourcify response; match labels retained literally (match is not exact_match). Proxy ABI retained when supplied. V2 proxy absent from Sourcify, bound by Etherscan Exact Match TransparentUpgradeableProxy page displaying implementation. No generic ERC4626 interface, repository-only ABI or fresh RPC attestation.
